title: Geoembeddings Convention
description: Schema for Geoembeddings Zarr convention, describing geospatial embedding groups with model provenance and processing metadata

node_type.description: Type of Zarr node (must be group)

attributes.description: Zarr attributes containing convention metadata and properties

geoemb:type.description: REQUIRED. Type of embedding: 'pixel' for per-pixel embeddings, 'chip' for image patch embeddings

geoemb:dimensions.description: REQUIRED. Dimensionality of the embedding vector

geoemb:model.description: REQUIRED. URL reference to the encoder model used to generate embeddings

geoemb:source_data.description: REQUIRED. URL references to the source datasets from which embeddings were derived

geoemb:data_type.description: REQUIRED. Data type of stored embeddings (e.g., 'float32', 'int8', 'uint16')

geoemb:spatial_layout.description: Spatial organization scheme. 'utm_zones': one group per UTM zone (utm01-utm60). 'global': single array in a global CRS.

geoemb:build_version.description: Version of the software that built this store

geoemb:benchmark.description: List of URLs to benchmark evaluation results

conventionMetadata.description: Geoembeddings convention metadata object for use in zarr_conventions array

schema_url.description: URL to the JSON Schema definition for this convention

spec_url.description: URL to the full specification document

uuid.description: UUID that permanently identifies this convention

name.description: Human-readable name of the convention using key-prefixed pattern

description.const: Geoembeddings convention for geospatial embedding arrays with model provenance
description.description: Brief description of the convention's purpose and usage

chipLayoutObject.description: Chip layout configuration for chip-type embeddings

chip_size.description: REQUIRED. Chip dimensions in pixels [height, width]

stride.description: Stride between chips [y, x]. Defaults to chip_size if not specified

grid_id.description: Identifier for a predefined grid system

original_dtype.description: REQUIRED. Original data type before quantization (e.g., 'float32')

link.description: URL to quantization codebook or lookup table

oneOf.description: Scalar scale: a single global scale and offset for linear dequantization
Array scale: per-pixel scale factors stored in a separate zarr array

array_name.description: Name of the zarr array containing per-pixel scales

nodata.description: Value in the scale array indicating no data (e.g., '+inf')
